### GT table: FBS vs. FCS margins

```{r gt-table-margins, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

gt_save_crop <- function(data, file = NULL, bg = "white", whitespace = 50, zoom = 2, expand = 5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch({
    gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
    message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
    gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  })

  magick::image_read(tmp) |>
    magick::image_trim() |>
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |>
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}

as_of_date <- "September 13, 2026"

# Long-format margin data (Season-to-date / Margin of Victory rows, one
# column per matchup type), pre-computed from collegefootballdata.com game
# data. Loaded here instead of hitting the CFBD API.
margin_data <- readr::read_csv("fbs_fcs_margin_2026-09-13.csv") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    section = factor(section, levels = c("Season-to-date", "Margin of Victory")),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = unique(metric))
  )

# FCS teams that beat an FBS opponent this season, "Winner score, Loser
# score" (extra detail like overtime length noted by hand where it applies).
fcs_upsets <- c(
  "Tarleton State 20, Bowling Green 13",
  "The Citadel 43, Charlotte 41 (3OT)",
  "Idaho State 29, Utah State 17",
  "Illinois State 28, Northern Illinois 24",
  "Montana State 20, Nevada 7"
)

is_avg_margin_row <- as.character(margin_data$metric) == "Avg Margin"

upset_note <- gt::html(paste0(
  "<b>FCS wins over FBS</b>:<br>",
  paste(fcs_upsets, collapse = "<br>")
))

margin_gt <- margin_data |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "section", rowname_col = "metric") |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::html("2026 Season<br>Games by Division"),
    subtitle = paste0("Games through ", as_of_date)
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(`FBS vs FBS`, `FBS vs FCS`),
    rows = is_avg_margin_row,
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    columns = metric,
    align = "left"
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(`FBS vs FBS`, `FBS vs FCS`),
    rows = !is_avg_margin_row,
    decimals = 0
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(`FBS vs FBS`, `FBS vs FCS`)) |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_brutalist(
    accent = "#00008B",
    density = "compact"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = gt::html(paste0(
      "<hr>\"Games Remaining\" reflects the rest of the season's schedule as ",
      "of ", as_of_date, ". <br>Margin thresholds are independent counts ",
      "(e.g. a 75-point game counts toward both “30 or more” and ",
      "“50 or more”).<hr>"
    ))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(source_note = upset_note) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = gt::html(
      "<hr>Data from collegefootballdata.com | Table by Chris at Bless your Chart"
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::px(475)
  )

gt_save_crop(
  margin_gt,
  file = "margin_by_division_tbl.png",
  whitespace = 40,
  bg = "white"
)

margin_gt
```

### GT table: Texas' comeback drive chart

```{r gt-table-drives, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

bin_labels <- c(
  "Own 0-9", "Own 10-19", "Own 20-29", "Own 30-39", "Own 40-49",
  "Opp 40-49", "Opp 30-39", "Opp 20-29", "Opp 10-19", "Opp 0-10"
)

game_label <- "Texas 24, Ohio State 23"

# Row-group label: just the team logo, as markdown gt can render (the image
# attribute syntax sets the height). Unknown teams fall back to a plain name.
offense_group_label <- function(teams) {
  lapply(teams, function(team) {
    clean <- cfbplotR::clean_school_names(
      as.character(team), keep_non_matches = TRUE
    )
    url <- cfbplotR:::logo_list[[clean]]
    if (is.null(url)) {
      return(gt::md(as.character(team)))
    }
    gt::md(sprintf("![](%s){height=22px}", url))
  })
}

# Per-drive field-position summary (drive, clock, offense, play counts by
# 10-yard bin, points), pre-computed from collegefootballdata.com play-by-play
# and drive data. Loaded here instead of hitting the CFBD API.
drive_table <- readr::read_csv(
  "texas_ohio_state_drive_position_2026-09-12.csv",
  col_types = readr::cols(clock = readr::col_character())
)

max_bin_count <- max(as.matrix(drive_table[, bin_labels]))

bin_fill <- function(x) {
  nonzero_fill <- scales::col_numeric(
    palette = c("#FDE68A", "#B91C1C"),
    domain = c(1, max_bin_count)
  )(pmax(x, 1))

  ifelse(x == 0, "#F2F2F2", nonzero_fill)
}

# Drive points: 0 = light pink, 3 = light green, 6-8 = darker greens.
points_pal <- scales::gradient_n_pal(
  colours = c("#FFB6C1", "#90EE90", "#1B5E20"),
  values = c(0, 3 / 8, 1)
)
points_fill <- function(x) {
  points_pal(scales::rescale(pmin(pmax(x, 0), 8), from = c(0, 8)))
}

drive_gt <- drive_table |>
  dplyr::group_by(offense) |>
  dplyr::arrange(drive) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = game_label,
    subtitle = "Shows number of offensive scrimmage plays by starting field-position."
  ) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    drive = "Drive",
    clock = "Clock",
    total_plays = "Plays",
    points = "Points",
    `Own 0-9` = "0–9",
    `Own 10-19` = "10–19",
    `Own 20-29` = "20–29",
    `Own 30-39` = "30–39",
    `Own 40-49` = "40–49",
    `Opp 40-49` = "40–49",
    `Opp 30-39` = "30–39",
    `Opp 20-29` = "20–29",
    `Opp 10-19` = "10–19",
    `Opp 0-10` = "0–10"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    columns = gt::starts_with("Own"),
    label = "OWN"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    columns = gt::starts_with("Opp"),
    label = "OPP"
  ) |>
  # Narrow spacer column between the OWN and OPP halves; drive is kept for
  # ordering but hidden from the rendered table.
  gt::cols_add(gap = "", .before = `Opp 40-49`) |>
  gt::cols_label(gap = "") |>
  gt::cols_width(gap ~ gt::px(14)) |>
  gt::cols_hide(columns = drive) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Plays from scrimmage (count)",
    columns = c(bin_labels, "gap"),
    level = 2
  ) |>
  gt::fmt(
    columns = bin_labels,
    fns = function(x) ifelse(x == 0, "", as.character(x))
  ) |>
  gt::data_color(
    columns = bin_labels,
    fn = bin_fill,
    apply_to = "fill"
  ) |>
  gt::data_color(
    columns = points,
    fn = points_fill,
    apply_to = "fill"
  ) |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_brutalist(accent = "#FF3B00", density = "compact") |>
  gt::text_transform(
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups(),
    fn = offense_group_label
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#E6E6E6"),
      gt::cell_text(color = "#1A1A1A")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  # Brutalist theme paints the spanner band black; keep its labels readable.
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "#FFFFFF", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_spanners()
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(gt::cell_borders(
      sides = c("left", "right", "top", "bottom"),
      color = "black",
      weight = gt::px(2)
    )),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_body(),
      gt::cells_column_labels()
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = gt::html(paste0(
      "Blank cells indicate zero plays from scrimmage in that ",
      "field-position bin.<hr>"
    ))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = gt::html(paste0(
      "Offensive plays from scrimmage only (runs, pass attempts, sacks, ",
      "turnovers). <br> Excludes special teams, penalties, kneels, spikes, and ",
      "timeouts. <br>Points is the offense's own scoring, so defensive and ",
      "special teams scores are not shown.<hr>"
    ))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Data via collegefootballdata.com | Table by Chris at Bless your Chart"
  )

gt_save_crop(
  drive_gt,
  file = "texas_ohio_state_drive_tbl.png",
  whitespace = 30,
  bg = "white"
)

drive_gt
```
